script_text: Stop! Leo, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mercury is forming a precise trine to Jupiter in your 12th House, while Mars squares your ruling planet, the Sun, in your 4th House. If you're single, Venus sextiling your 5th House draws magnetic, romantic attention through a creative or social setting. A surprising blessing arrives via your 2nd House — unexpected money or a useful resource appears. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
